items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 「猫尾酒馆」的招牌调酒师，迪奥娜，我的出场费可是很贵的。唔？你居然…不是为了酒才来的？哼，那你的邀请…我就勉为其难地接受了。
items.text_en: Diona, bartender of the Cat's Tail! I charge a hefty fee for private events. Huh? You didn't come here for a drink? Hmm... Then I accept your invitation... I suppose...

items.title: 闲聊·放松
items.text: 哈~~好舒服，身体都变得更柔软了。
items.text_en: Ahhh... that stretch feels good.

items.title: 闲聊·思考
items.text: 蜥蜴尾巴、胡椒、星螺…还差点什么才能调出「难喝到头脑炸裂的酒」呢？呜…
items.text_en: Hmm. Lizard Tail, Pepper, Starconch, hmm... what else do I need to create the most dreadfully disgusting cocktail?

items.title: 闲聊·等待
items.text: 才，才没有在等你。我只是，正好在休息而已！
items.text_en: I—I wasn't waiting for you. I just happened to be resting!

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 呜呜…讨厌下雨…去屋子里吧。唔，只是因为弄干衣服很麻烦！才不是什么怕水呢！
items.text_en: Rain! I hate rain! ...Let's go inside... I—I'm not scared of water, I just... hate it when my clothes get wet.

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 欸？！…我没有在发抖！没有！…呜…
items.text_en: Ahh!!! Uhh, um... I'm not shaking, I'm not... Ohhhh...

items.title: 下雪的时候·玩雪
items.text: 这个凉飕飕的触感，哇…好棒，好有趣。
items.text_en: Ooh, it's so cold to touch. Wow, it's so much fun!

items.title: 下雪的时候·观雪
items.text: 白茫茫的雪在风里跳舞，真好看呢。嗯…我旁边的座位还空着，没人坐哦。
items.text_en: Ooooh, look at the little white snowflakes dancing in the wind, to and fro, and... whew, isn't it... beautiful! C'mon, c'mon c'mon, sit with me... Watch...

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 走喽，晒太阳…你不去我可就自己去了哦…唔，最后一次机会！走不走！
items.text_en: Come on, let's go bask in the sun a bit~ ...If you aren't coming, I'll just go by myself~ ...Last chance! Are you coming or not!?

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早，把橱柜里那罐腌泥鳅递给我一下——好咧，我要开始摧毁蒙德酒业啦。
items.text_en: Morning~ Can you hand me that can of salted loach from the cabinet? Time to destroy the wine industry!

items.title: 中午好·异响
items.text: 咕噜噜…嗯？没有！你什么都没有听到！
items.text_en: Wha— Ugh, no! You heard nothing!

items.title: 中午好·罐头
items.text: 这个鱼肉罐头是我好不容易省下来的，别，别看啦！最多…最多只能给你尝一口。
items.text_en: Uh, I was saving this can of fish for when I was really hungry. Stop looking at it like that! ...Mmm, okay, I'll let you have a little taste, but nothing more!

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 失败了…又失败了…大家都喝得好开心，呜…别安慰我，我才不需要安慰…
items.text_en: Aw, I failed... Ugh, again... Everyone loved my drinks! Gah... Don't try to comfort me. I—I don't need comforting!

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 你没有猫的夜视能力，走夜路不要紧吧？要我护送你的话…欸，有灯啊？…谁，谁要护送你啦，快点走快点走。
items.text_en: Without cat vision, will you be okay walking home in the dark? If you need me to escort you... What? Th—There's lights? Pff, well who said anything about escorting you? Go on now.

items.title: 关于迪奥娜自己
items.text: 耳朵和尾巴才不是什么装饰，是「凯茨莱茵家族」血统的象征，真是少见多怪。呃…你、你把手伸过来干什么？这个…唔…好吧，耳朵的话可以让你摸一下…但是尾巴、尾巴绝对不可以！
items.text_en: My ears and tail are no prop, they're real. Proof of my Kätzlein bloodline. It's only weird to you cause you've never seen it before. Wh—Why are you looking at me like that? Fine. You can touch my ears for a second, but the tail is off limits!

items.title: 关于我们·饮料
items.text: 想喝无酒精饮料？难倒是不难，但是没有意义！无论成功还是失败，都和摧毁蒙德酒业的目标没有关联。我才不会做呢。
items.text_en: You want a non-alcoholic drink? No, that's not difficult, but it's meaningless! It doesn't have anything to do with my grand plan of destroying the wine industry of Mondstadt. I won't waste my time on such a drink, hmph!

items.title: 关于我们·贵宾渠道
items.text: 喏，这个是「了不起的夏日梦幻忧郁珊瑚气泡茶」，只是因为最近无聊才做的。热门产品？排队抢购？你在说什么呢，我可没听见。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Here! I call this Fantastic Summer-Serendipity Coral Sparkling Tea, I just made it one day when I was bored... Huh, you say it's popular? People are lining up to buy it? Don't be ridiculous.

items.title: 关于我们·聊天需要
items.title_en: About Us: The Need to Chat
items.text: 唔…要是，要是你感觉孤单了，我可以随便陪你聊聊天。我还是知道很多事情的哦！也是很好的…那个叫什么，说话对象哦。没错没错！来跟我，多说说话吧…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Well, if you ever feel lonely, you can chat with me. I know lots of cool things~ I'm a good... what's that called... chatting partner! Yes! A good chatting partner, come chat with me... lots... ...okay?

items.title: 关于我们·好奇心
items.text: 是什么是什么？你拿着的是什么？快给我看看！说不定丢到酒里能做出相当难喝的…啊，什么嘛，原来只是长得奇怪了点的蘑菇而已呀，真无趣。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6What's that!? What's that!? Let me see! Maybe I can add it to my next cocktail to give it a dreadful taste... Huh? It's just a strange-looking mushroom, how boring...

items.title: 关于「神之眼」·遗传
items.text: 问我的「神之眼」是怎么来的？哼，是、呃…是凯茨莱茵的家族遗传！唔？杜拉夫先生根本没有神之眼？欸——露馅了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3How did I get my Vision? Simple — everyone in the Kätzlein lineage gets one. ...Huh? Then why doesn't Draff have a Vision? Uhh... Oh no, the cat's out of the bag! Eek!

items.title: 关于「神之眼」·来历
items.text: 为什么非得告诉你啦，哼！算了，看在你一直追问的份上，看在…看在我们是朋友的份上。那次我爸爸外出打猎，差点出大事，在大雨中，我脑袋里想的全部事情就是要找到他，救出他…好了啦，满意了吧！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Why should I tell you!? Hmph! ...*sigh* Since you won't stop asking... and since we are friends, I'll tell you: One time, my daddy went missing on a hunt in a big storm. All I could think of was finding him, saving him... That's it, are you happy now!

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 龙脊雪山上，会不会长着奇珍异草呢。「拥有致命的苦味」或者「沾到一点就嘴巴发麻」这样？要拔好多下来！然后…嘿嘿嘿…嚯嚯。
items.text_en: Hey, do you think there are any exotic plants on Dragonspine? Maybe something with a deadly bitterness, or something that numbs your mouth upon contact? I'm going to pick a lot! And then... hehehe-hee-hee...

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 我扑…捕捉蝴蝶的技巧可是一流的。喂，不是啦！抓蝴蝶是为了加进酒里做出难吃的味道，不要把我当成猫啦！喵！
items.text_en: When it comes to butterflies, I'm the best at pouncing on— err, catching them. Hey, not in a fun way! I catch butterflies to add a nasty taste to my cocktails. I'm not a cat! Meow! *hiss*

items.title: 关于迪卢克
items.text: 那个…迪卢克，是我最讨厌的人！没有迪卢克就不会有蒙德酒业，没有蒙德酒业爸爸就不会喝酒，爸爸不喝酒就…就会陪我了，哼。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Diluc... I can't stand him! If there was no Diluc, there would be no Mondstadt wine industry; if there was no Mondstadt wine industry, Daddy wouldn't drink; and if Daddy didn't drink... he would keep me company. Ohhhh...

items.title: 关于凯亚
items.text: 为什么连我的「护卫队长」也是个令人讨厌的酒鬼啦！就是那个，说起话来总是笑盈盈的家伙！喝起酒来一杯接一杯的，没完没了。呼！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4How is it that even a captain is a disgusting boozehound! You know, that guy who's got that laugh! He downs drink after drink. Ugh!

items.title: 关于温迪
items.text: 温迪？不太熟的样子。但说到吟游诗人，就是那伙会给酒鬼们唱歌助兴的人吧。那就不喜欢！不喜欢不喜欢。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Venti? I'm not familiar with him... He's a bard? Oh, he must be that guy who sings tunes to entertain the drunkards. Well, then I don't like him, no no no...

items.title: 关于芭芭拉
items.text: 芭芭拉小姐的粉丝们，都是大哥哥大姐姐…好羡慕，为什么我的粉丝都是一群大叔呢。呜…可恶，哼，不想了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4How come all my fans are drunk middle-aged men, while Barbara's are all young people...? Hmph! So stupid. Forget it!

items.title: 关于琴
items.text: 琴啊，骑士团的代理团长，嗯…难得一个不喝酒的成熟大人…但总感觉认真过了头，骑士团的大家对我有些过度保护了吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius... A rare, mature adult who doesn't drink... But perhaps a little too earnest, cause is it just me, or are the Knights overdoing it a bit on protecting me?

items.title: 关于阿贝多
items.text: 首席炼金术士大人？唔…我这种一直调出好酒的体质，他会知道破解的方法么？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Alchemy genius? Hmm... I wonder if he knows of a way to finally help me make a drink that people don't like?

items.title: 关于丽莎
items.text: 丽莎姐姐，很和善对吧，很温柔对吧？但是，这样的姐姐也经常喝酒！呜呜呜…这是为什么啦…蒙德城已经没救了吧…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Lisa is so nice and gentle! But... how can such a gentle person also be a regular drinker!? Ohhhh... Why!? ...There's really no hope for Mondstadt, is there?

items.title: 关于香菱
items.text: 我向香菱讨过一份「口感搭配特别糟糕的食物组合」，据说是她亲自实践下来的，绝对难吃什么的…没用，完全没用。「续杯」两个字已经听到猫耳朵都生茧了！呜…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Xiangling once gave me a "so-awful-it-goes-with-nothing" food combination she came up with, saying how it tasted absolutely terrible, blah blah blah... It didn't work, no use at all. All my little cat ears heard that night was "One more cup of that good stuff!" *sigh*

items.title: 关于可莉
items.text: 可莉每次来找我玩的时候，我都只好把她带去离酒馆远一点的地方。酒和炸弹…实在是太危险了！就算我想摧毁蒙德酒业，也得用堂堂正正的方式。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Every time Klee wants to play with me, I take her somewhere far from the tavern. Alcohol and explosives... yeah, that's a dangerous combination! I mean, do I want to destroy the wine industry of Mondstadt? Yes, but not in that sense!

items.title: 关于父亲
items.text: 爸爸是我最尊敬的人！爸爸是最厉害的人！但是…喝了酒的爸爸，唔——果然还是要早点终结蒙德的酒业！没时间闲聊啦！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I adore my daddy more than anyone else! He's the greatest! But... Daddy after he drinks, ugh... Argh! I must bring an end to the wine industry of Mondstadt, and soon! No time for chit-chat!

items.title: 想要了解迪奥娜·其一
items.text: 「调酒师」可是很忙的！即使不在酒馆工作，也要抽出时间来收集配方。所以，所以没有要紧事情的话，就不要来打搅我。
items.text_en: Life as a mixologist is very busy! When I'm not at the tavern, I'm out collecting ingredients for new recipes. So... So unless something is urgent, don't bother me.

items.title: 想要了解迪奥娜·其二
items.text: 你不会…也像那些讨厌的酒鬼一样要我学猫咪叫吧？不会的，绝对不会的！我才不是什么抖抖耳朵伸伸懒腰的宠物！我可是…可是…「酒业杀手」！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3You wouldn't ask me to meow like a cat, like those boozehounds at the tavern do, would you? I wouldn't do it, no way! I'm not some little house pet that just shakes my ears real cute and stretches my back! I'm... I'm Diona, Destroyer of the Wine Industry!

items.title: 想要了解迪奥娜·其三
items.text: 你问我…为什么「酒业杀手」变成了「猫尾酒馆」的招牌…？你，你是故意这样问的吧！就是想看我的笑话。呜，坏人！再也不给你调喝的了，水也不给！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4"How did the Destroyer of the Wine Industry become the Cat's Tail's mascot...?" Y—You're asking this just to make fun of me! Ohhh, you're awful! I won't be giving YOU any more drinks, not even water.

items.title: 想要了解迪奥娜·其四
items.text: 别再惹我了啊，我宽容大度，但也不好欺负！我警告你，我生起气来可是会咬人的！喵！虽然不一定舍得咬你…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Don't, don't make me angry. I'm pretty tolerant, but don't even try to mess with me. I'm warning you, I bite when I get angry! Meow!!! ...But maybe I'd let you off easy, no bites...

items.title: 想要了解迪奥娜·其五
items.text: 我和你…已经成为好朋友了，对吧。我隐约记得…我以前也有过这样一个朋友，但我不确定那是不是梦…把你的手给我。啊呜，唔…暖和的。这样就好，不要变成梦走了…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6You and me... we're good friends now, right? I kind of remember having a friend like this before, but maybe it was a dream... Here, give me your hand. Ahh... Hmm, nice and warm... Very nice... please don't leave me, and become another dream.

items.title: 迪奥娜的爱好
items.text: 我喜欢打猎，追捕猎物可是我的强项！但爸爸说野外情况瞬息万变，只有跟着可靠的大人一起，才能深入森林。你…算是可靠的大人吧？
items.text_en: I enjoy hunting. I'm especially good at tracking down prey! But Daddy says that the wild is dangerous. One should only go deep into the forest with a reliable adult. ...You're a reliable adult, right?

items.title: 迪奥娜的烦恼
items.text: 嗯…到底怎样才能调出难喝的酒呢…连我给予厚望的噩梦搭配——「酱油牛奶绝云椒椒配蒲公英籽特调」都被说成是「小迪奥娜又有进步了」，呜…我不会认输的…
items.text_en: How, oh how can I make awful-tasting drinks...? I had high hopes for the soy sauce, milk, Jueyun Chili, and Dandelion Seed cocktail — my most nightmarish combination to date! But even that was met with praise at the tavern. "This is Little Diona's best drink yet..." Grr! But I won't give up...

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 我喜欢吃鱼！作为主食的鱼…爸爸做的鱼！但是…不要作为下酒菜，那是对鱼的亵渎！
items.text_en: I like, no, LOVE to eat fish! The fish Daddy cooks is the best, a purrfect main course! ...But eating fish as drunk food, that's absolute blasphemy!

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 胡萝卜、土豆、洋葱、番茄…这些味道都不太喜欢。我，我可不是吃素的啊！
items.text_en: Carrots, potatoes, onions, tomatoes... I don't like the taste of any of those vegetables. ...In fact, I don't eat vegetables at all!

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 好吃…我，我就随便问一下哦，下次还有吗？
items.text_en: Mmm! I just wanna ask you this... Will you bring more of it next time?

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 你可别指望我尝了点甜头，就会来蹭你…
items.text_en: I'll admit, that was pretty sweet... but that doesn't mean I haven't had sweeter.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 喂…你是把我当成路边的野猫了吗！
items.text_en: Hey... What do you take me for, some sort of stray cat!?

items.title: 生日
items.text: 炸鱼，配上这个我特别调制的酱料，给你。…没有加奇怪的东西！我认真调味的手艺才不会差呢，先尝过才可以说话。哼…这才对嘛…唔，那个，生日快乐。
items.text_en: Here you go — fried fish with my special sauce! ...Relax, I didn't add anything strange! My cooking is actually really good when I want it to be — stop talking and try it already! Hmph... that's better... Oh, and uh, happy birthday.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 猫的眼睛，看得见黑暗中的一切猎物！
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 1A cat's eyes can see even the most elusive prey in the dark.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 猫的耳朵，听得见地上最细微的脚步声。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 2A cat's ears can hear even the softest footsteps on the ground.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 猫的四肢，爬得上全提瓦特最高的树。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 4A cat's legs can climb even the tallest tree in all of Teyvat.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 猫的鼻子，闻得出熟悉的、喜欢的人的…唔？！是你听错了！我怎么可能说出那种话…呜…
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 6A cat's nose can smell those people they are familiar with and like... Ahh!? You're mistaken, how could I say something like that... Ohh...

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 嘿…呀！
items.text_en: Hey-yah!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 咻咻——
items.text_en: Pew-Pew~!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 目标确认。
items.text_en: On the rocks!

items.title: 元素战技·其四
items.text: 攻守兼备。
items.text_en: Shaken and stirred!

items.title: 元素战技·其五
items.text: 抓到你了！
items.text_en: Scratched ya!

items.title: 元素战技·其六
items.text: 我可不好欺负！
items.text_en: Think you can bully me?!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 迪奥娜特调！
items.text_en: Diona Special!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 贪杯的下场…哼！
items.text_en: Can't handle your drink? Hmph!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 反省吧，酒鬼！
items.text_en: Look at you, boozehound!

items.title: 冲刺开始·其一
items.text: 唔，来了。
items.text_en: Ha, I'm here.

items.title: 冲刺开始·其二
items.text: 出发，出发！
items.text_en: Let's go, let's go!

items.title: 冲刺结束·其一
items.text: 呼。
items.text_en: Phew.

items.title: 冲刺结束·其二
items.text: 哈唔…
items.text_en: Phew, hoo.

items.title: 打开风之翼·其一
items.text: 飞起来喽。
items.text_en: I'm flying!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 让酒变难喝的材料啊，出现吧！
items.text_en: If it doesn't ruin a drink, it isn't treasure!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 亮晶晶的…想要…扑过去！
items.text_en: So glittery... Must... control... urge to pounce...

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 宝箱里有些什么，我很好奇！
items.text_en: Potential treasure... *sigh* Alright curiosity, you win again!

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 我不会认输…！
items.text_en: I won't accept defeat!

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 喵…喵…！
items.text_en: Meow...!

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 胜负还没分呢！
items.text_en: It's not over yet!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 太乱来啦！
items.text_en: Be more careful!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 去休息去休息！
items.text_en: Take a breather!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 酒的味道…好臭…
items.text_en: Bleugh... I smell wine.

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 泉水精灵…不要走…
items.text_en: Spring fairy... ugh... Don't leave me...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 眼睛…睁不开了…
items.text_en: Can't keep my eyes... open...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 没躲开…
items.text_en: Got me that time...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 从哪里来的？
items.text_en: Where'd that come from!?

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 狩猎开始！
items.text_en: The hunt begins!

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 果然需要我出手嘛！
items.text_en: Huh, need my help as usual?

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 哼，就包在我身上。
items.text_en: Hehe, leave it to me!
